name: link_prediction
author: 92711a92
description: Predicts likely missing edges: ranks node pairs that are not linked yet by how likely a link between them is, from their shared neighbourhood. Use it for questions like 'who should Alice connect with next?', 'which new route is most likely?' or 'which two characters probably know each other?'. Methods: adamic_adar (default; shared neighbours, rare ones count more), resource_allocation, jaccard, common_neighbors, preferential_attachment. Give node to get predictions for one node only, or leave it out to rank all pairs. Works on undirected graphs; on directed graphs edge direction is ignored. Weights are ignored. Returns the top_k pairs (source and target with id and label), each with its score and number of common neighbours.

graph_id.description: Id of the graph to analyse.

node.description: Optional node id: only predict new links for this node. Leave out to rank every unlinked pair. Use lookup_node to find ids.

top_k.description: How many predicted links to return.
